messages:
maya: Quick postmortem follow-up for the Acadia dedicated outage (VPC peering + on‑prem routing instability). Consolidating action items here — please ack and pick owners.

thomas: Can you TL;DR the root cause so we can scope fixes?

maya: tl;dr: a race in the isolation-controller's route reconciliation + a transient BGP session drop on the customer's edge. The controller hit a lock contention path and skipped reprogramming some peer routes -> traffic was routed to default path briefly.

eli: Noted. I'll own customer comms and the verification window with Acadia. Target: coordinate a maintenance window in the next 48h.

sanjay: I'll own the rollout/runbook side: canary plan + automated smoke for peering changes. ETA for canary plan doc: 72h.

thomas: I'll take the isolation-controller patch (reduce lock scope + deterministic reconcile). Plan: small patch, unit tests, and an integration run against a simulated onprem BGP. ETA: 7 days.

maya: Action list (assigning owners):
- isolation-controller concurrency fix (thomas) — 7d
- metric + alert for peer_reconcile_duration (thomas) — 3d
- onprem BGP test harness + repro case (thomas + eli) — 5d
- customer verification window & comms (eli) — 48h
- canary + post-deploy smoke tests for peering (sanjay) — 72h
- runbook update: isolation recovery steps + fallback policy (sanjay) — 5d
- ticketing + SLO impact and customer compensation plan (vivian) — 48h

vivian: I'll draft the SLO impact note and a compensation proposal for Acadia. Will loop in legal if needed.

eli: For verification, propose these steps to run during the maintenance window: 
1) Bring down BGP session on a test edge for 60s
2) Confirm peer_reconcile_duration < 10s and no stale routes
3) Run routing check on 3 nodes: `birdc show route` / `ip route`
4) Smoke test end-to-end requests for a pinned tenant

maya: Adding a quick repro snippet for the infra folks:

```
# simulate onprem BGP flap (test harness)
ip netns exec onprem0 vtysh -c 'configure terminal' -c 'neighbor 10.0.0.1 shutdown'
sleep 60
ip netns exec onprem0 vtysh -c 'neighbor 10.0.0.1 no shutdown'
```

maya: We're also tracking that this is the third peering-related isolation class incident in ~6 months for dedicated/private customers. Two follow-ups: (1) make the peer_reconcile_duration alert a P0 for dedicated clusters, (2) run a monthly peering stress test in staging.

thomas: Agreed. I'll instrument `peer_reconcile_duration` + `peer_reconcile_failures` and add a dashboard. Will also add a short-term alert: >30s AND >3 failures in 1h.

oncall-bot: GitHub issue created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/issues/4972 (acadia/peering-reconcile)

eli: Quick question — do we need to notify other Dedicated customers about this pattern? Might be worth a heads-up email and recommended mitigations.

vivian: Yes, but hold off until we have patch + verification plan. I'll prepare a templated notice that we can send post-fix.

maya: CI/integration notes: thomas, please add a flaky test case that simulates lock contention. sanjay, add the peering smoke to nightly canaries (stage -> prod path).

thomas: Will do. Also adding a short-term hotfix patch: reduce lock granularity and force a reconcile on BGP session flaps. PR will reference the GH issue.

eli: I'll schedule the Acadia window for tomorrow 02:00-04:00 UTC and post the verification checklist.

vivian: acked. I'll prep the SLO impact doc and sync with Acadia PM after the window is scheduled.

maya: I'll own the post-deploy retrospective next week to confirm regressions are closed and update the master remediation tracker.

sanjay: adding: runbook change — explicit step to trigger a forced reconcile and a manual fallback to a secondary peering route. I'll submit the runbook PR.

thomas: +1 to that runbook change. Also suggest we add an automated nightly check: compare route tables across nodes and alert on divergence > 0.

maya: Good. Closing notes: please add your GH PRs and docs to the issue linked above. Mark items done in the incident tracker. We'll have a short sync 24h after the maintenance window to verify.

eli: :thumbsup:

vivian: :+1:

thomas: Started a draft branch for the controller patch. Will post PR in the issue when ready.

oncall-bot: Reminder scheduled: Post-deploy sync in 24h (2864591234).

maya: Thanks everyone — feel free to ping me if anything slips.
